notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry
description:
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mirrorhall Mimic // Ghastly Mimicry's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
